finding: Failed standalone package verification retained its output and blocked retries.
change: Preserve the exclusive output creation and existing verification order; on failure, remove only that invocation-owned output and re-raise. Successful receipts and pre-existing-output rejection remain unchanged.
checker_semantics: Package validation and admission checks are unchanged. The checker script content identity changes and release package evidence must be rebuilt.
coverage: Actual incomplete archive set rejects and permits retry using the same output path
Injected receipt-write failure removes a partial receipt
Injected interruption removes temporary build files and owned output
Successful wrapper call retains exactly its receipt
Existing output is rejected before verification and retains its bytes
qualification: Receipt-success, receipt-write and interruption tests replace the expensive inner checker with controlled outcomes. Full packaged-application execution remains a separate exact-commit CI gate. The before run had three assertion failures and one retry error; all 16 after tests passed.
